## What this does

Every IRI family SIG mints in **new** releases moves to the owned
`surveillancegraph.org` base (B-6), while every already-published IRI stays
immutable and meaningful through an append-only alias map + a published compat
note.

- **One declared base per surface.** Ontology/schema + vocabulary families mint
  under `https://ontology.surveillancegraph.org/` (`ontology/generate.py` `BASE`,
  the LinkML schema ids, `vocab/predicates.yaml`, `build_predicates.py`);
  PROV-O under `https://surveillancegraph.org/prov/` (`exports/provo.py`);
  JSON-LD `@vocab` under `…/ns/` (`exports/formats.py`); API subject IRIs under
  `…/id/` (`api/dereference.py`); OCFL `user.address` and watch-feed UIDs on the
  bare owned domain (`evidence/ocfl.py`, `web/src/lib/watch.ts` — closing
  `D-P35.3-1`). Each minted namespace sits behind exactly one declared constant.
- **Compat, not rewrite.** `docs/governance/iri-base-alias-map.json`
  (`sig.iri-alias-map/1`, append-only) maps every retired base family — twelve
  families covering the ontology/vocab schemes, PROV, JSON-LD, `/id/`, OCFL,
  watch UIDs and the crawler contact URL — as a name mapping that is explicitly
  *not* an HTTP-redirect claim; `docs/governance/iri-base-compat-note.md` is the
  published note. Deployed sqitch artifacts and their seed IRIs are never
  edited — the hosted vocabulary re-mint call is recorded debt
  (`D-P35.38b-1`); the organised-editing disclosure's placeholder contact is
  `D-P35.38b-2`.
- **ADR-217** records the decision, the B-6 alternative set, the immutable-release
  consequences and the residual squatting risk on the unregistered domains
  (recorded `RISK-R11-29`, not bought away); homed on BL-085 in the backlog,
  trigger-register row `quiet` at authoring, Appendix F row added + spec rebuilt.
- **Provenance truth (F5 PKG-09b).** `provenance.ttl` now emits the real bound
  captures: `claim_binding_detail` joins `ingest_run` so each capture carries its
  recorded `retrieved_at` (never the export's `generated_at`), content digest,
  S-6-gated upstream reference, and its retrieving run's connector name/version
  + start/finish; the export activity `prov:used` every bound capture. No
  binding rows → honest skeleton, never fabricated captures. Canonical
  N-Triples stay byte-deterministic.
- **The guard.** `tests/unit/test_identity_base.py` (9 tests): a `git grep`
  sweep fails any `sig-project.org`/`sig.example` literal outside the declared
  history/exempt regions, fails a second hard-coded emitter of any minted
  namespace, and pins the alias-map shape/coverage, the compat note, and
  ADR-217's revisit trigger.

## What this does not do

- No published identifier is rewritten — deployed migrations, landed records,
  the risk register, ADR bodies and historical artifacts keep their old-base
  literals inside declared history regions; the alias map names the mapping.
- No domain is purchased and no registrar is contacted (B-6 — the squatting
  residual is recorded risk, not bought away).
- The hosted `vocab_*` seed rows are not re-stamped — that is a DB-side call on
  a new sqitch change, filed `D-P35.38b-1` (the predicate join key is the slug,
  never the IRI, so nothing joins on the old base).
- The OSM organised-editing disclosure's `osm-contact@sig.example` is not
  repointed — needs a provisioned contact + real routes + the external wiki
  edit (`D-P35.38b-2`); the guard exempts those two files verbatim.
- No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no claim-spine write, no HG gate ticked, no
  production deploy — new minting ships with the next release build.
